messages:
maya: FYI recruiter flagged several templates where rubric weights show as blank after yesterday's editor rollout. spotted during scheduling.
aj: confirmed one candidate (app-4321) where 'technical' weight reverted to default.
sasha: that sounds like the sanitizer tweak that strips unknown data-* attrs. weights are stored as data-weight on each question node.
aj: the deploy went out 2024-05-24T22:10 UTC, matching the timeline.
janet: running a quick query to enumerate affected templates: SELECT id FROM scorecard_templates WHERE data->>'weights' IS NULL AND updated_at >= '2024-05-24T22:00:00Z'; found 29 templates, 5 of them with active interviews.
ryan: I can pull audit entries and restore weights. prefer backfill over asking panels to rescore.
emma: please pause reminder emails for those 5 template ids until we finish backfill.
naomi: I'll draft a short comms: "Heads up: you might notice slight scorecard display changes. We're auto-restoring rubric weights; no action needed unless we ping you."
sasha: opened PR to whitelist data-weight in sanitizer and added a small migration to rehydrate missing attrs from audit logs.
deploy-bot: rollback scheduled if PR not merged within 15m; infra on standby.
ryan: ran dry-run of backfill script, matched 29/29. starting apply in small batches to avoid notifier spam.
janet: verified on two sample active interviews: weights restored and historical scores unchanged.
naomi: done 1f44d reminders re-enabled and recruiters notified. closing the loop.
